lines.t: Mountains bow down at his feet
Rivers flow where his love meets
The stars hum His name sweet and clear
The truth, the light, the song I sing
Every breath, every step, to Him I cling
Chains break with a single call
Grace catches me when I fall
His mercy's wider than the skies
Who can stand, who can stay
When His glory lights the way
Yahushua, my King of kings The truth, the light, the song I sing
Every breath, every step to Him I cling No crown of gold, no throne of pride
A humble heart, the world's guide Through every storm He's by my side
